topics.name: #UM UserModule Root
topics.purpose: Define `#UM` as the reserved root for registered UserModule definitions and explicit runtime instances, with module identity independent from library path and instance identity distinct from definition identity.

semantics.definition_rule: Registered UserModule definitions have explicit stable canonical identities.
semantics.instance_rule: Runtime instance identity is distinct from UserModule definition identity where multiple instances are supported.
semantics.type_rule: UserModule primary type is explicit: command, input, adapter or view unless a composition contract says otherwise.
semantics.path_rule: Library/storage path does not define UserModule identity.
semantics.lifecycle_rule: Installed, registered, enabled and running states remain separate.
semantics.authority_rule: Module registration/visibility does not grant execution or write authority.

invariants.rule: Each reserved runtime root resolves to one explicit semantic owner/family; the root itself never creates semantic ownership or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: UserModule identity inferred solely from path
definition identity conflated with instance identity
module type inferred from implementation behavior
registration automatically enables or executes module
